title: Voyage pack registry
description: One record per voyage pack. The single source of truth tying a pack to every surface it ships on (landing card, PDFs, offline HTML render, PWA companion). Checked against the files on disk by admin/scripts/check-voyage-registry.mjs. Soli Deo Gloria.

slug.description: The pack source basename without .md; also the value carried in every usage event as `pack`.

status.description: shipped: at least one buyer deliverable exists. companion-only: PWA but no PDF. source-only: markdown only. sailed: the voyage is in the past.

sail_start.description: First itinerary date, from the companion's window.__VOYAGE or the pack source. null for a generic pack or an unverified date.

sail_end.description: Last itinerary date. Where the companion does not carry it, derived as sail_start plus the night count in the pack title.

price_usd.description: Price shown on the landing page, or null when the pack is not sold there.

landing.description: true when a product card for this pack exists on /voyage-packs.html.

html.description: Repo-relative path of the offline HTML render, or null.

pwa.description: Repo-relative path of the PWA companion page, or null.

instrumented.description: Flipped by the task that adds usage events to each surface; the dashboard's coverage panel is derived from these, never asserted.
